Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Message.Name: Security Open Message
Message.Description: The options system plans to disseminate the Option Open Message for each option as soon as the opening is completed. Upon receipt of the open state message, firms should be advised that the option denoted in the message is now available for auto execution within the PHLX ® Options Market System. Upon receipt of the closed state message, firms should be advised that the option is no longer eligible for auto-execution within the Options Market System.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Open State
Field.Description: Open State value

Message.Name: Add Order Short Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Message indicates that a new order has been accepted by the options system and was added to the displayable book. The message includes a day-unique Order Reference Number used by options system to track the order.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Order Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The unique reference number delta assigned to the new order. The order reference number is Increasing, but not necessarily sequential.

Field.Name: Market Side
Field.Description: The type of order being added. Note: AON order is not posted on the option’s book. Hence it should not be used to calculate the best bid/ask.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily, valid for trading day.

Field.Name: Short Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order being added to the book. NOTE: When converted to a decimal format, this price is in fixed point format with 3 whole number places followed by 2 decimal digits.

Field.Name: Short Volume
Field.Description: The total number of contracts of the new order being added to the book.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: PHLX assigned order ID.

Message.Name: Single Side Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever a Side order is executed in whole or in part. It is possible to receive several Single Side Executed Messages for the same Side order if that Side order is executed in several parts. The multiple Single Side Executed Messages on the same order are cumulative. By combining the executions received separately via two types of Single Side Executed Messages and Trade Messages, it is possible to build a complete view of all non-auction executions that happen on PHLX ®. Auction execution information is available in one bulk print via the Auction Trade Message.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The order/quote reference number delta associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Executed Contracts
Field.Description: The number of contracts executed.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Message.Name: Single Side Executed with Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an incoming Side order is executed against the book in whole or in part at a price different from the initial display price. Since the execution price is different than the display price of the original Add/Replace, the options system includes a price field within this execution message. It is possible to receive multiple Single Side Executed and Single Side Executed with Price messages for the same Side order if that Side order is executed in several parts. The multiple Single Side Executed messages on the same Side order are cumulative.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Reference Number Delta
Field.Description: The order/quote reference number delta associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Cross Number
Field.Description: Trade Group Id. Ties together all trades of a given atomic transaction in the matching engine.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Execution Id. Identifies the component of an execution. Unique for a given day. The match number is also referenced in the Trade Break Message.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be reflected on time and sale displays and volume calculations.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: The execution contracts.

Value.Name: Start of Messages. This is always the first message sent in any trading day.
Start of System Hours. This message indicates that PHLX ® is open and ready to start accepting orders.
Start of Opening Process. This message is intended to indicate that PHLX ® has started its opening auction process.

End of Normal Hours Processing - This message is intended to indicate that PHLX ® will no longer accept any new orders or changes to existing orders for options that trade during normal trading hours.
End of Late Hours Processing - This message is intended to indicate that PHLX ® will no longer accept any new orders or changes to existing orders for options that trade during extended hours.
End of System Hours. This message indicates that PHLX ® options system is now closed.
End of Messages. This is always the last message sent in any trading day.
End of WCO Early closing. This message is intended to indicate that the exchange will no longer accept any new orders or changes to existing Orders on last trading date of WCO options.
Buy Side Trading Suspended or Exhausted
Value.Description: Buy Side Trading Suspended/Exhausted –i.e. Buy orders are not executable and Buy side book is non Firm.

Value.Name: Sell Side Trading Suspended or Exhausted
Value.Description: Sell Side Trading Suspended/Exhausted –i.e. Sell orders are not executable and Sell side book is non Firm.
